findings.text: follow-on: the only test that would fail if one of the 124 added labels were removed is the graph-marked test_four_arm_table_matches_the_control_below_every_arm, which the recorded default gate deselects, so the added labels carry no guard in the gate the manifest reports.
follow-on: the manifest names no baseline_suite and no after_suite, so added_failure_count for the reviewed run is unmeasured rather than zero and no regression delta against its base can be derived.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base 631206b8; one commit 7a5c056d, three files, all inside the declared scope; the fixture delta is 124 added labels across 18 questions, 0 changed, and the two fragments are new.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when (FENCE-EVIDENCE) names the fragment recording mean nDCG@10 and grade-3 precision@5 per arm under each text, no stored vector, and full label coverage; the manifest records the measurement run and the harness gate.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to measure description-only against name+description+unit as the embedding text on the golden set in memory; docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/embeddings.html records both texts on both arms, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 7 passed/4 deselected on the harness plus a measurement EXIT=0, and names its logs, but carries no baseline_suite/after_suite so added failures are unmeasured.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: the only repository test that reddens if a label in tests/llm/fixtures/signal_search_questions.json is removed is graph-marked at tests/llm/test_signal_search_goldens.py:695 and is deselected by the gate the manifest records, so the landed data's guard did not run.
justifications.evidence: the measure is recorded, not claimed — .../reports/imas-codex/signal-embed-text/results.json carries the table and its headline equals the fragment's numbers.
justifications.fit: the fragment and node fragment follow the sibling fragment idiom, and the added question/fixture names introduce nothing the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/embeddings.html:1 records mean nDCG@10 and grade-3 precision@5 for both texts on both arms over the in-memory eligible JT-60SA population.
justifications.reuse: the diff defines no new function, class or module, so it forks no capability; a search for an existing embed-text composition owner in imas_codex/embeddings and imas_codex/discovery/signals found none.
justifications.scope_discipline: the three landed paths (embeddings.html, ssfms-embed-text-measure.html, tests/llm/fixtures/signal_search_questions.json) are exactly the declared write paths, and the fixture delta is pure addition.
